It is compatible with all trackers utilizing appearance features and provides additional features to train/fine-tune ReID models using the TripletsDataset. clean_summary:
The LocateAnything model rethinks bounding box prediction for vision-language detection. It decodes bounding boxes in parallel rather than one coordinate at a time, which improves localization accuracy and increases throughput. Trained on 138 million high-quality samples, it is designed for AI agents and robots to quickly and accurately pinpoint objects in visual scenes.

The model is part of a research paper that is trending at CVPR 2026 and is available on HuggingFace. It offers a unified framework for generative grounding and detection, accelerating decoding while enhancing high-IoU localization quality.
